patterns.note: Content is presented in a predominantly single-column, centered layout with generous vertical spacing between distinct sections, often featuring full-width abstract 3D illustrations or photography.
Headings use a large, bold sans-serif font for strong impact, while body text uses a clean, readable sans-serif with ample line height, creating a clear typographic hierarchy.
The site uses a high-contrast palette of a very light, almost white background with dark navy/charcoal text, punctuated by a vibrant teal accent color for calls to action and key graphic elements.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the abstract 3D background elements move at a slower rate than the foreground text as the user scrolls down the page.
A persistent, dark-themed announcement banner ('Rhino + Jetty') remains sticky at the bottom of the viewport throughout the scroll, providing a constant call to action or information.
Abstract, sculptural 3D illustrations are integrated into various sections, serving as visual anchors and adding a modern, sophisticated aesthetic without being literal product imagery.

technique_notes: The hero section combines a full-width background image or video (as hinted by 'video-hero') with a centered text overlay. As the user scrolls, the background elements are designed to move at a slightly different speed than the main content, creating a subtle parallax depth effect.
A sticky header navigation bar is implemented, maintaining visibility and access to primary navigation links as the user scrolls down the page.
A persistent, full-width banner is fixed to the bottom of the viewport, ensuring a key announcement or call to action is always visible.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual hierarchy, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif body text and smaller, often uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: subtle — mostly sharp corners, with very subtle rounding on buttons and some card elements.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous vertical and horizontal padding creates a spacious, uncluttered feel, especially in the hero and between major sections.

standout: The distinctive use of abstract, sculptural 3D illustrations integrated seamlessly into the page layout, rather than traditional photography or flat icons, gives the site a unique, sophisticated, and modern aesthetic. This visual language elevates the brand beyond a typical financial service provider.
